in_sanskrit.name: अमृता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows nectar or immortality

in_marathi.name: Amruta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of immortality
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amruta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amruta is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amrutam’ which means ‘nectar’ or ‘immortality’. In Hindu mythology, Amruta is the name of the heavenly drink which grants immortality. The Gods were believed to drink Amruta from the divine cow Kamadhenu.
